bonooru.description: Plays melodies on the in-game ocarina by emulating a wired Switch 2 controller (2x RP2040-Zero + Rust desktop app). Unofficial fan project.

the-debugger-0x3-wild-shift.description: A top-down action boss rush where you shift your weapon's bits mid-fight. Made for GitHub Game Off 2026 (theme: SHIFT) — https://itch.io/jam/game-off-2026

mumble-speech.description: Video-game mumble speech synthesis (Undertale, Banjo-Kazooie, Animal Crossing styles). Rust core with web, Godot, Unity and C bindings.

jsf-autoreload.description: maven plugin to enable hot reload on jsf projects

hugo-to-devto-action.description: Composite GitHub Action that mirrors new Hugo posts to dev.to as drafts
